storyTagline: The Texans end Skura's title run in Super Bowl CXLIX, Bones Crawford repeats as MVP, Calvin Wingo II arrives and Danny Diggs retires as a Broncos back takes his record.

stories.headline: Houston Ends It: Texans Beat the Eagles in Super Bowl CXLIX
stories.dek: Philadelphia went 14-3, won two home playoff games and lost 32-22 to the Texans, ending a run of eight straight titles for Dorren Skura.

stories.headline: Spector Gets His Ring, Against the Club That Sent Him Away
stories.dek: Two years after the trade that swapped him for Gerrit Ogbah, Siran Spector ran for 29 touchdowns and won a title over Philadelphia.

stories.headline: Crawford and Rahman Win Their Awards Again
stories.dek: The quarterback took a second straight MVP and passed 200 touchdown passes. His top receiver won Offensive Player of the Year for the second time.

stories.headline: Calvin Wingo II Fills the Biggest Hole in Philadelphia
stories.dek: With Vyncint Heath gone, the rookie caught 120 passes for 2,218 yards and was named Rookie of the Year.

stories.headline: Washington Splits Again as the Eagles Lose Only on the Road
stories.dek: The Commanders went 13-4 and won the rematch in week 16. The Rams beat Philadelphia by a point in the regular season, then lost to the Eagles in the playoffs.

stories.headline: Diggs Retires, and a Broncos Card Takes His Touchdown Record by One
stories.dek: Danny Diggs left with 408 rushing touchdowns. Lane McCoy arrived with 409, and Tim Wright passed 350.

stories.headline: No Hall of Fame Class in Y90, but Stidham Is at the Door
stories.dek: Terron Stidham passed 3,000 tackles and sits just under the bar. Damar Hobbs arrives 3 interceptions from Daren Teamer's record.

stories.headline: Heath, Diggs, Teamer and Seven More Walk Away
stories.dek: Ten veterans are retired, among them a two-time Super Bowl MVP, the career interceptions leader and an eight-ring defensive back.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Dennis Baylon
vault.text: Seven trips to the Super Bowl. Seven rings. Not one loss. Career Legacy 10,074, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Cairo Asanjh
vault.text: Some players chase records. Cairo Asanjh chased Ian Finney. Career Legacy 10,031, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Jackson Wardell Kline
vault.text: Tyrion Kline's son did not live in anyone's shadow. He built his own. Career Legacy 9,797, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Charlie John
vault.text: Seven straight Super Bowls. Charlie John was there for every one of them. Career Legacy 9,723, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Wayne Wilson
vault.text: Four hundred thirty-one games. Nobody in this league has played longer. Career Legacy 9,154, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Lukas Russell
vault.text: The Running Man started fast and never slowed down. Career Legacy 9,037, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Jayon Queen
vault.text: Two Defensive Player of the Year awards. Only one other player in this league has ever matched that. Career Legacy 8,651, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Ray Waller
vault.text: Never count out a man whose nickname is a promise. Career Legacy 8,642, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Zander Kolar
vault.text: Some defensive linemen are measured in sacks. Zander Kolar was measured in tackles. Career Legacy 8,488, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Nick Bolton
vault.text: One of the originals, and he never stopped tackling. Career Legacy 8,465, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Jahmyr Gibbs
vault.text: Mr. Incredible was here at the start, and he set the bar high. Career Legacy 8,411, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Jawill Perkins
vault.text: Few linemen have ever been busier on a snap-for-snap basis than Jawill Perkins. Career Legacy 8,230, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Bilal Tolbert
vault.text: No individual trophies. Four rings. And a sack record nobody has caught. Career Legacy 8,207, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Tyrone Baugh
vault.text: Seven seasons, seven championships, and Tyrone Baugh has a ring for every one of them. Career Legacy 8,207, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Amani Bryant
vault.text: The best quarterback never to win a ring. Career Legacy 7,999, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Lamar Jackson
vault.text: The league never had to explain who he was. He was just Him. Career Legacy 7,864, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Mose Junior
vault.text: Some players chase rings. Mose Junior chased ball carriers. Career Legacy 7,661, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Tyler Pacheco
vault.text: Tyler Pacheco never needed the big play. He needed the ball, and he got it. Career Legacy 7,562, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Akiem Bouye
vault.text: Akiem the Dream was there at the beginning. Career Legacy 7,561, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Lloyd Queen
vault.text: Some linemen hunt quarterbacks. Lloyd Queen hunted everybody else. Career Legacy 7,437, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Michael Wilson
vault.text: Wayne's brother, and nobody's afterthought. Career Legacy 8,508, Y79 class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Dan Mosley
vault.text: 2,658 tackles from a defensive back. Read that again. Career Legacy 7,620, Y79 class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Jakeem Friend
vault.text: Linemen do not win trophies. Jakeem Friend won seven rings instead. Career Legacy 10,081, Y80 class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Jason Macleone
vault.text: One look at Scary Jerry and you understood the name. Career Legacy 7,745, Y80 class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Pharoah Hunter
vault.text: The other receiver in the Vikings dynasty was never anybody's second option. Career Legacy 7,725, Y80 class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Abraham Ward Jr
vault.text: Eleven tackles a game, every game, for 236 games. Career Legacy 7,445, Y82 class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Malakai Sawyer
vault.text: Some backs have a great season. Malakai Sawyer keeps having them. Career Legacy 8,145, Y84 class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Juwann Gilman
vault.text: Thirteen seasons in Arizona, and almost twelve tackles every time he takes the field. Career Legacy 7,438, Y85 class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Kalif Suh
vault.text: A Jets linebacker since Y76, and the middle of that defense has rarely moved without him. Career Legacy 8,733, Y86 class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Ryland Maxwell
vault.text: Seven rings, and the best rushing seasons the record board has ever seen. Career Legacy 8,742, Y87 class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · K'Lavon Settle
vault.text: Fifteen seasons in San Francisco, and nobody on a card has made more tackles. Career Legacy 7,667, Y87 class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Calais Ham
vault.text: Four Super Bowl rings on the Atlanta line. Career Legacy 7,858, Y87 class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Aqib McClain
vault.text: One tackle. That is all that separates Aqib McClain from the most tackles any defensive lineman has ever made. Career Legacy 8,225, Y88 class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Keion Orzech
vault.text: Sixteen seasons in Dallas, and the Cowboys front has had Keion Orzech in it for every one of them. Career Legacy 7,319, Y88 class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Daren Teamer
vault.text: Eleven tackles a game is a Hall of Fame habit, and Daren Teamer has never broken it. Career Legacy 8,192, Y89 class.

vault.title: Broncos Series: 5–0
vault.text: Skura met the Broncos in 5 Super Bowls and won all 5: LXXV (Y16) W 22–16, LXXXII (Y23) W 46–11, LXXXIV (Y25) W 38–16, CXLIII (Y84) W 32–28 and CXLVII (Y88) W 40–22.

vault.text: Skura met the Texans in 4 Super Bowls and went 3–1: XCVII (Y38) W 24–16, CXLV (Y86) W 48–13, CXLVI (Y87) W 30–21 and CXLIX (Y90) L 22–32.

vault.title: Bengals Series: 4–0
vault.text: Skura met the Bengals in 4 Super Bowls and won all 4: LXII (Y3) W 30–22, CXXVII (Y68) W 32–14, CXLIV (Y85) W, score not recorded and CXLVIII (Y89) W 44–14.

vault.title: Buccaneers Series: 4–0
vault.text: Skura met the Buccaneers in 4 Super Bowls and won all 4: LXX (Y11) W 30–20, LXXXVIII (Y29) W 40–33, XCIX (Y40) W 38–22 and C (Y41) W 40–28.

vault.title: Commanders Series: 2–3
vault.text: Skura met the Commanders 6 times in Y88, Y89 and Y90 and went 2-3-1: Y88 week 4 L 24-29, Y88 week 13 T 40-40, Y89 week 8 L 30-33, Y89 week 14 W 30-20, Y90 week 11 W 30-28 and Y90 week 16 L 24-28.
